prompt:

No rice, no pineapple, no trees, no plants or obstacles anywhere directly ahead of the tractor on that lane. Paddy fills the sides and back in perfectly aligned grid rows.
Preserve the polished miniature stylized 3D isometric appearance, soft warm daylight, charming proportions, detailed tidy plants. Entire circular base visible and centered on square canvas, balanced margins, subtle contact shadow.
Genuinely transparent alpha background, not a blue backdrop or checkerboard. No text, no labels, no watermark, no people, no trees, no pineapple. Final asset is square PNG for 1000 x 1000 pixel export.
